newsitem.title: USA: Motorola wins $40 mln Philippine contract.
newsitem.headline: Motorola wins $40 mln Philippine contract.

text.p: Motorola Inc said Wednesday its Asia Pacific Cellular Infrastructure Group has won a supply contract from Pilipino Telephone Corp valued at $40 million.
The contract calls for installation of CDMA (Code Division Multiple Access) in Pilipino Telephone's Mobiline cellular telephone network in the Philippines.
Motorola will supply, install and optimize the CDMA digital network, which includes the switch, radio and intelligent network.
Arrangements to put the network in place will begin during the first quarter of 1997 with commercial service scheduled to begin by mid-year.
Once deployed, Pilipino Telephone's network will provide service to 60,000 subscribers in metropolitan Manila.
Motorola is a provider of wireless communications, semiconductors and advanced electronic systems.
